class.name: NNHTNBinding
class.brief_description: Resource that iterates candidate targets from a world-state array as method arguments.
class.description: Add to [member NNHTNMethod.bindings] when a method should try each item from an [Array] in the blackboard (such as nearby coins, cover points, or enemies) as a candidate value for [member variable], backtracking to the next item if planning fails. Candidates can be sorted with [member order] (for example, [constant NEAREST] to the agent) and filtered with [member conditions] before planning tries them. [codeblock] var binding := NNHTNBinding.new() binding.state_key = "coins" binding.variable = "target" binding.entry_field = "node" binding.order = NNHTNBinding.NEAREST binding.origin_key = "agent_position" method.bindings.append(binding) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_validation_errors
method.description: Returns configuration error messages for this binding, or an empty array if valid.

members.member: Optional filter conditions each candidate must pass (with the candidate available under [code]args.<variable>[/code]).
Optional dot-separated [Dictionary] field path extracted from each array entry as the bound value.
Order in which candidates are tried ([constant SOURCE], [constant NEAREST], or [constant NUMERIC_FIELD]).
Dot-separated path to a numeric sort key when [member order] is [constant NUMERIC_FIELD].
World-state blackboard key holding the [Vector3] origin when [member order] is [constant NEAREST].
Dot-separated path to each entry's [Vector3] position when [member order] is [constant NEAREST].
World-state blackboard key holding the source [Array] of candidates.
Method argument name that receives each bound candidate.

constants.constant: Tries candidates in their original array order.
Sorts candidates closest first relative to the [Vector3] at [member origin_key].
Sorts candidates ascending by the numeric value at [member order_field].
